title: Core parts are excluded from both the inventory and special-order result sets
refs: SV-8645 (PV spec v10 2026-08-17 S5-R1; S5-R2; §3 Key Decisions)
preconds:
1. An inventory part flagged as a core has in-window sales activity and on-hand stock.
2. A vendor-sourced core part was requested on an invoiced/paid work order in the window..
steps:
1. Search the report for the inventory core part (Type = Both).
2. Search for the special-order core part.
expected:
1. The inventory core part does NOT appear in the report despite its activity and stock.
2. The special-order core part does NOT appear either.
3. Parts flagged as a core are excluded from both result sets by design.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Parts Velocity report specification version 11 (S5-R1, S5-R2), read on 17 August 2026.
